description: The file defines a PHP trait named RequestTrait within the Laminas\Diactoros namespace. It provides common behaviors related to HTTP request handling, such as URI creation, request target management, HTTP method handling, and related utility functions. This trait is used to share common functionality between different request classes in the Laminas Diactoros PSR-7 implementation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes or resets request state with optional URI, method, body, and headers. Sets the Host header if not present and URI contains a host.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates and returns a UriInterface instance based on the input, which can be a UriInterface, string, or null. Throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the request target URL, defaulting to '/' if none is set, constructed from URI path and query.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target after validating it does not contain whitespace.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, validating it.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI interface instance associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new request instance with the provided URI, optionally preserving the Host header.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Validates and sets the HTTP method for the request.

methods.name: getHostFromUri
methods.description: Constructs a host string from the URI's host and port.
